items.name: Shadowfang
items.notes: Iconic low-level one-hand sword from Shadowfang Keep and a common melee-twink weapon at this bracket; much of its value is the no-level-req weapon enchant it carries. This is a seed anchor — verify the exact required level (~18), stats, off-hand pairing, and current-meta status against the Wowhead Rogue BiS guide at authoring, and fill the remaining rogue-specific slots there.
